Class SessionFacade

java.lang.Object
ry.ms.businessLogic.user.login.SessionFacade
public class SessionFacade extends Object
A Facade for managing user sessions, including login. This class provides a simplified interface to the session management subsystem. It is implemented as a Singleton to ensure only one instance exists.

    • loginUser

      public User loginUser(String mail, String password) throws UserDoesntExistException, SQLException, IncorrectPasswordException
      Attempts to log in a user with the given credentials. It delegates the call to the UserManager.
      Parameters:
      mail - The user's email address.
      password - The user's password.
      Returns:
      The authenticated User object.
      Throws:
      UserDoesntExistException - if no user is found with the given email.
      IncorrectPasswordException - if the password does not match.
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs.

      public User registerUser(String email, String password, String username) throws UserAlreadyExistsException, SQLException, UserCreationException
      Registers a new user.
      Parameters:

      password - The user's password.
      username - The user's username.
      Returns:
      The newly created User object.
      Throws:
      UserAlreadyExistsException - if a user with the given email already exists.
      UserCreationException - if there is a database error during creation.
